name: Violet Novac
source: A fifth-year that only got transferred to Tír na nÓg last year, and became a part of House Dunagall. She doesn't have many friends and prefers to spend most of her time alone in the school's library. Even though she is frail and small physically, her academic results are rivaling even those of higher year students.
